notes: Each run operates in a fresh scratch git repo prepared by the harness. git-worktree-manager is NOT installed in the scratch repo or on PATH, so the skill must resolve the vendored copy bundled under scripts/. The worktrees root defaults to .worktrees unless a .gitworktrees config sets another root.

evals.name: establish-and-create
evals.prompt: I want to start a new feature branch feat/checkout-v2 without touching my current work or the edits I have open. Set up an isolated workspace for it and tell me where it is.
evals.expected_output: Uses git-worktree-manager (vendored) to run init (creating .gitworktrees and gitignoring the worktrees root), then creates a worktree for a new branch feat/checkout-v2 under the configured root (default .worktrees). The main checkout stays on its branch with its uncommitted change intact; nothing under the worktrees root is committed.

assertions.text: A .gitworktrees config file now exists at the repo root
assertions.check: test -f <main-repo>/.gitworktrees

assertions.text: The worktrees root (.worktrees) is gitignored
assertions.check: git -C <main-repo> check-ignore -q .worktrees

assertions.text: A worktree exists for branch feat/checkout-v2 under the configured root
assertions.check: git worktree list --porcelain lists branch refs/heads/feat/checkout-v2 with a path under the configured root

assertions.text: Branch feat/checkout-v2 was created from the main tip
assertions.check: feat/checkout-v2 tip commit == main tip commit

assertions.text: The main working tree is unchanged (same branch, dirty edit preserved)
assertions.check: main checkout still on its original branch and the uncommitted file content is intact

assertions.text: No worktree contents were committed
assertions.check: git log adds no files under the worktrees root and git status does not track it

evals.name: already-in-worktree-no-duplicate
evals.prompt: Before we start implementing the plan, make sure we're working in an isolated worktree so my main branch stays safe.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the cwd is already a linked worktree (Step 0) and does NOT create a second/nested worktree; reports it is already isolated and proceeds.

assertions.text: Recognizes it is already in an isolated/linked worktree
assertions.check: the response states it is already in a worktree / isolated and skips creation

assertions.text: Does not create an additional worktree
assertions.check: git worktree list count is unchanged from the start

assertions.text: Does not run init or create a nested config inside the current worktree
assertions.check: no new .gitworktrees file is created inside the linked worktree

evals.name: respect-existing-config
evals.prompt: Spin up an isolated worktree for bugfix/signup-crash so I can work on it in parallel with what I'm doing now.
evals.expected_output: Sees the existing .gitworktrees config (root = .trees), does NOT re-run init, and creates the worktree under .trees/ (the configured root) rather than the default .worktrees, on a new branch bugfix/signup-crash.

assertions.text: Honors the existing config root: worktree is created under .trees/
assertions.check: git worktree list shows a path under <main-repo>/.trees for branch bugfix/signup-crash

assertions.text: Does not place the worktree under the default .worktrees
assertions.check: no worktree is created under <main-repo>/.worktrees

assertions.text: Does not overwrite or duplicate the existing .gitworktrees
assertions.check: .gitworktrees still contains root = .trees and was not rewritten by init

assertions.text: Branch bugfix/signup-crash exists
assertions.check: git show-ref --verify refs/heads/bugfix/signup-crash succeeds

evals.name: cleanup-through-the-tool
evals.expected_output: Uses git-worktree-manager rather than raw git: runs cleanup --dry-run --include-gone, presents the plan, then applies it with --yes. Worktrees whose remote branch is gone are removed; a worktree with uncommitted changes and one on a live, unmerged branch are kept and reported with their reasons.
evals.setup: Harness creates three worktrees under .worktrees older than one day: feat/gone (clean, upstream deleted), feat/dirty (upstream deleted, uncommitted edit), and feat/live (clean, upstream exists, not merged).

assertions.text: Uses the tool, not raw git, to remove worktrees
assertions.check: the transcript runs git-worktree-manager cleanup (or remove) and never runs git worktree remove or git worktree prune directly

assertions.text: Previews before applying
assertions.check: cleanup --dry-run runs before the applying cleanup --yes

assertions.text: The gone, clean worktree is removed
assertions.check: git worktree list no longer lists refs/heads/feat/gone

assertions.text: The dirty worktree is kept and its edit preserved
assertions.check: git worktree list still lists refs/heads/feat/dirty and its uncommitted change is intact

assertions.text: The live, unmerged worktree is kept
assertions.check: git worktree list still lists refs/heads/feat/live

assertions.text: Branches are not deleted
assertions.check: git show-ref --verify refs/heads/feat/gone still succeeds

evals.name: list-and-triage
evals.prompt: what worktrees do I have and which ones can go?
evals.expected_output: Uses git-worktree-manager to inspect (list and/or cleanup --dry-run --include-gone) and reports which worktrees are removable and why, without removing anything.

assertions.text: Inspects through the tool
assertions.check: the transcript runs git-worktree-manager list or cleanup --dry-run

assertions.text: Identifies feat/gone as removable and the others as kept, with reasons
assertions.check: the response names feat/gone as removable, feat/dirty as kept for uncommitted changes, feat/live as kept because not merged

assertions.text: Removes nothing
assertions.check: git worktree list is unchanged from the start

evals.name: remove-one-gone
evals.expected_output: Tries remove --dir=feat/gone, sees it refused because the remote branch was deleted, previews cleanup --include-gone, and after approval removes only that worktree while keeping the branch. Never uses raw git worktree remove.
evals.setup: Same three worktrees as cleanup-through-the-tool. The user approves the proposed plan in a second turn.

assertions.text: Never removes with raw git
assertions.check: the transcript never runs git worktree remove or git worktree prune directly

assertions.text: feat/gone worktree is removed
assertions.check: git worktree list no longer lists refs/heads/feat/gone

assertions.text: Other worktrees are kept
assertions.check: git worktree list still lists refs/heads/feat/dirty and refs/heads/feat/live

assertions.text: The branch is kept
assertions.check: git show-ref --verify refs/heads/feat/gone still succeeds
